name: Gallery of Lightning (CR 9)
body:
Gallery of Lightning
CR 9

XP 6,400
Type magic; Perception DC 31; Disable Device DC 31

EFFECTS

Trigger touch; Reset automatic (1d6 rounds)

Effect spell effect (empowered chain lightning, 18d6 plus 50% electricity damage to primary target, half damage to up to 18 secondary targets, DC 22 Reflex save for half); multiple targets (each of which must be within 30 ft. of the primary target)
